name: prone-quad-stretch
instructions:
1. In a prone position, keep the head relaxed and lift one leg toward your glutes.
2. Grab the foot with your ipsilateral hand and gently pull up to increase the stretch on the quad.
3. Keep the knee pointing straight down and hold for the desired number of repetitions or time.
4. Repeat steps 1-3 on the other leg.
